notes: SWE-bench-shaped debugging task on the real mypy tree. The seed is the actual upstream bug: ExpressionChecker.analyze_type_type_callee substitutes the TypeVar instance into the constructor callee's return type only for CallableType/Overloaded callees; when T is bounded by a union of classes the callee is a UnionType and the substitution is skipped, so every constructor call through a Type[T] parameter is checked against 'A | B' instead of 'T' and factory functions are littered with 'Incompatible return value type' errors. The agent is told the user-visible symptom only - no issue number, no commit, no file name, no reproduction code - and must write its own failing /app/repro.py first, then localize and fix, then write /app/diagnosis.md naming the module and the return-type substitution cause. The verifier runs the agent's repro and 3 authored hidden cases (two-arg constructors, nested-union bound Union[A, Union[B, C]], class-method factory) against the pristine parent tree (must fail with the bug's error) and against the repaired tree (must pass), then overlays the fix commit's three test-data files and runs the project's own pytest suite on the repaired tree: the golden regression case testTypeUsingTypeCConstructorReturnFromTypeVarUnionBound, the whole testTypeUsingTypeC family (26 existing cases, proves nothing else broke), the upstream-updated match-arm case testMatchTypeObjectTypeVar (an extra behavioral gate: the reveal must become 'T_Choice`-1'), and the PEP 695 case testPEP695UpperBoundTypeTypeConstructorReturnType. Provenance gates hash-check the test runner (mypy/test/{testcheck,data,helpers,config,typefixture}.py), the non-overlaid check-class-namedtuple.test, the buggy checkexpr.py at the pristine copy, and the /opt/golden files, and require .git to be absent. Verified both directions inside the built image: parent reproduces 2 'Incompatible return value type' errors and all gate tests fail; after the oracle's fix everything passes (measured: build ~13s, image 780MB unique, mypy CLI ~3.4s per run, pytest -k runs ~2.2s each). difficulty_guess from the issue pool was 'medium'.
